what_it_is: PC400 is a .020-inch coil designed for aneurysms and fistulas; comes in complex and helical shapes
indications: Indicated for the embolization of intracranial aneurysms, other neurovascular abnormalities such as arteriovenous malformations and arteriovenous fistulae, and arterial and venous embolizations in the peripheral vasculature
use_notes:
Method of Detachment: Instant mechanical detachment
Coil Type: Complex standard, complex soft, curve extra soft, complex extra soft

[FDA RECALL] 1 active recall(s).
  - The diameter of a component of the device is out of tolerance specification; the Delivery Pusher pull wire which secures the coil in place can prolapse and allow premature detachment of the coil.
